title.zh: 如果校門前，早上二十分鐘沒有車？
title.en: What if the school gate had twenty car-free minutes?

description.zh: 虛構的青溪社區，用三輪審議討論學校周邊徒步街。人物、發言、觀察、票數與決定皆為示範編寫。
description.en: The fictional Qingxi neighborhood explores a school street over three deliberative rounds. People, statements, observations, votes and decisions are all authored for this demo.

disclaimer.zh: 全部資料皆為模擬。沒有建立真實活動、呼叫 AI 生成、送出通知或代表任何居民意見。
disclaimer.en: All data are synthetic. No real activities were created, AI generation called, notifications sent or residents represented.

title.zh: 第 1 輪：先聽懂，找出分歧

goal.zh: 學校周邊是否適合在上下學時段試辦徒步街？先釐清安全、通行與生計。
goal.en: Could a school street work at arrival and dismissal? Clarify safety, access and livelihoods first.

focus.zh: 遺漏的接送與配送需求

input.zh: 社區對校門口安全、通行與生計的初始關切，以及決策權限與本輪範圍。
input.en: Initial community concerns about school-gate safety, access and livelihoods, together with decision authority and the scope of this round.

output.zh: 學校周邊是否適合在上下學時段試辦徒步街？先釐清安全、通行與生計。
output.en: Could a school street work at arrival and dismissal? Clarify safety, access and livelihoods first.

guidance.zh: 先確認能改什麼、由誰回覆；本案例全部是虛構示範。
guidance.en: Clarify what can change and who must respond; this entire case is fictional.

input.zh: 初始議題簡介、可近用需求，以及需要主動接觸的受影響社群。
input.en: The initial issue brief, access needs and affected communities that need active outreach.

output.zh: 8 則表單意見；聯絡方式與意見分開保管。
output.en: 8 form comments; keep contact details separate from views.

guidance.zh: 線上表單搭配電話或現場邀請，讓夜班、照顧者與無網路者能進來。
guidance.en: Pair the online form with calls or in-person invitations so shifts, caring duties and internet access do not exclude people.

input.zh: 本輪 12 位虛構參與者的觀點分布。
input.en: The perspectives of 12 fictional participants this round.

output.zh: 涵蓋缺口紀錄；本示範採定向邀請，未做抽樣。
output.en: An inclusion-gap record; this demo uses purposive invitation, not a random sample.

guidance.zh: 大型公民會議可另用可稽核抽樣；小型工作坊也必須說清楚誰缺席。
guidance.en: For a citizens’ assembly consider auditable selection; a small workshop must still explain who is missing.

input.zh: 原始意見、背景材料與可查證的問題。
input.en: Source comments, background materials and questions that can be checked.

output.zh: 4 則 Call-in 提問，作為後續回覆的來源。
output.en: 4 Call-in questions, retained as sources for later responses.

guidance.zh: 共同讀資料、現地走讀或線上問答；保留更正與不同立場的證據。
guidance.en: Use shared reading, a site walk or online Q&A; retain corrections and evidence from different positions.

input.zh: 8 則表單意見、4 則問題及補訪。
input.en: 8 form comments, 4 questions and follow-up interviews.

output.zh: 4 則訪談意見與 4 個附來源主題。
output.en: 4 interview comments and 4 source-linked themes.

guidance.zh: Harmonica 補訪缺席聲音，TTTC 協助整理；此處主題是預先編寫的模擬，需主持人覆核。
guidance.en: Harmonica reaches missing voices and TTTC organizes material; these themes are pre-authored simulation and require facilitator review.

input.zh: 附來源的主題、提問與 4 項可修訂方案。
input.en: Source-linked themes, questions and 4 revisable proposals.

output.zh: 12 位模擬參與者 × 4 題，共 48 筆同意／不同意／略過。
output.en: 12 simulated participants × 4 statements: 48 agree/disagree/pass responses.

guidance.zh: 先討論理由再比較陳述；計數不等於共識、代表性民意或授權。少數理由仍要留下。
guidance.en: Discuss reasons, then compare statements. Counts are not consensus, representative opinion or a mandate; retain minority reasons.

input.zh: 4 項候選方案、模擬投票與原始提問。
input.en: 4 candidate proposals, simulated votes and source questions.

output.zh: 模擬主辦者同意把「四週試辦」列為候選；無障礙接送與配送安排未完成前不啟動。
output.en: The fictional organizer keeps a four-week pilot as a candidate; it cannot start until accessible drop-off and deliveries are addressed.

guidance.zh: Pocket Reply 草擬逐題回覆，主辦者覆核後才形成自己的承諾；模型不能代替有權決定者。
guidance.en: Pocket Reply drafts question-linked replies; the organizer reviews before making commitments. A model cannot replace the authorized decision-maker.

input.zh: 本輪回覆、修正要求與仍未解決的問題。
input.en: This round’s responses, correction requests and unresolved questions.

output.zh: 配送與到宅照顧者尚未充分參與；接送例外仍需共同設計。
output.en: Delivery and home-care perspectives are under-covered; access exceptions still need joint design.

guidance.zh: 回到招募：補邀到宅照顧者與巷弄居民，再用訪談及現地走讀修訂方案。
guidance.en: Return to invitation: include home-care workers and side-street residents, then revise through interviews and a site walk.

text.zh: 學校周邊是否適合在上下學時段試辦徒步街？先釐清安全、通行與生計。
text.en: Could a school street work at arrival and dismissal? Clarify safety, access and livelihoods first.

text.zh: 校門口接送車遮住轉角視線，希望先改善過街安全。
text.en: Cars at the school gate block sightlines; improve crossing safety first.

text.zh: 我每天走路經過，不能只在校門前安全。
text.en: I walk here daily; safety needs to extend beyond the school gate.

text.zh: 店裡早上要進貨，整條路封閉會影響營業。
text.en: Our shop receives morning deliveries; a full closure would affect business.

text.zh: 輪椅上下車需要靠近入口，不能一律把車擋在外面。
text.en: Wheelchair users need a drop-off near the entrance; a blanket ban would exclude us.

text.zh: 希望先短期試辦，也看一下旁邊巷子會不會塞車。
text.en: Try a short pilot and watch whether traffic moves into side streets.

text.zh: 配送路線能配合，但要先說清楚時間與替代停靠區。
text.en: I can adjust deliveries if the hours and alternative loading area are clear.

text.zh: 早上老師要顧校門，需要有人協助引導路口。
text.en: Teachers watch the gate in the morning; someone must help at crossings.

text.zh: 自行車也可能和孩子衝突，徒步區內應該牽行。
text.en: Bikes can also conflict with children; people should dismount inside the zone.

text.zh: 這是虛構的定向邀請小組，沒有執行隨機抽樣，也不代表全體居民。
text.en: This is a fictional purposively invited group. No random selection was performed and it does not represent all residents.

text.zh: 實際有權核准試辦的是誰？
text.en: Who has actual authority to approve the pilot?

text.zh: 無障礙接送如何保留？
text.en: How will accessible drop-off remain available?

text.zh: 誰承擔試辦成本與引導工作？
text.en: Who pays for the pilot and coordinates crossing stewards?

text.zh: 若巷弄塞車或有人無法進出，要如何暫停？
text.en: How can the pilot pause if side streets clog or someone loses access?

text.zh: 市場收攤時間和放學接近，需要一起討論。
text.en: Market closing overlaps with dismissal; include those schedules.

text.zh: 早上的會議我在補眠，希望能晚上留言。
text.en: I sleep after a night shift; please let me contribute in the evening.

text.zh: 公車站離校門遠，如果換接送點，要有清楚指標。
text.en: The bus stop is far from the gate; a new drop-off needs clear wayfinding.

text.zh: 我支持孩子走路，但下雨天與行動不便的情況怎麼辦？
text.en: I support walking to school, but what happens in rain or for people with limited mobility?

text.zh: 過街安全與學習
text.en: Crossing safety and learning

text.zh: 無障礙與照顧通行
text.en: Accessibility and care access

text.zh: 配送、生計與執行成本
text.en: Deliveries, livelihoods and implementation cost

text.zh: 巷弄影響與檢討責任
text.en: Side-street effects and review responsibility

text.zh: 先試辦四週，上下學各封閉二十分鐘。
text.en: Run a four-week pilot with twenty-minute closures at arrival and dismissal.

text.zh: 保留近入口的無障礙接送及緊急通道。
text.en: Keep accessible drop-off near the entrance and an emergency route.

text.zh: 全面禁止上下學時段配送。
text.en: Ban all deliveries during arrival and dismissal.

text.zh: 共同量測路口安全與鄰近巷弄交通。
text.en: Jointly measure crossing safety and traffic on neighboring streets.

text.zh: 模擬回覆 1：本輪已連結原提問與方案；模擬主辦者同意把「四週試辦」列為候選；無障礙接送與配送安排未完成前不啟動。
text.en: Fictional response 1: this round links the source question and proposal. The fictional organizer keeps a four-week pilot as a candidate; it cannot start until accessible drop-off and deliveries are addressed.

output.zh: 試辦經費由誰負擔仍未解決；未採納的店家分攤方案要有理由。
output.en: Funding remains unresolved; the rejected shop cost-sharing proposal needs an explanation.

guidance.zh: 回到共同學習：帶入模擬觀察紀錄、經費選項和參與者更正，再檢討是否延長試辦。
guidance.en: Return to learning: bring simulated observations, funding options and participant corrections, then review whether the pilot should continue.

text.zh: 納入接送、配送與巷弄觀點，將第一輪分歧改成可檢查的試辦條件。
text.en: Include access, delivery and side-street perspectives; turn disagreements into checkable pilot conditions.

text.zh: 可先從早上做，放學時段等第一階段檢討後再決定。
text.en: Start with mornings and review before adding dismissal hours.

text.zh: 現地走讀才看到路口斜坡不平，需要先補平。
text.en: The site walk revealed an uneven ramp that needs repair first.

text.zh: 配送可以提前，但要有清楚的臨停告示。
text.en: Deliveries can arrive earlier if the loading signs are clear.

text.zh: 無障礙接送應設通行窗口，不應讓個人健康資訊公開。
text.en: Accessible drop-off needs an access window without publishing personal health information.

text.zh: 巷口應放觀察點，不能只量校門前。
text.en: Place an observation point at the side street, not only at the gate.

text.zh: 給配送一個前後緩衝時間，比全面禁止可行。
text.en: A buffer before and after the closure works better than a blanket delivery ban.

text.zh: 引導員輪值要有明確負責人，不能都算老師的工作。
text.en: Name the crossing-steward coordinator instead of assuming teachers can do everything.

text.zh: 可用活動式標誌，保留救護車緊急通行。
text.en: Use movable signs to preserve emergency access.

text.zh: 這是虛構的定向邀請小組，沒有執行隨機抽樣，也不代表全體居民。
text.en: This is a fictional purposively invited group. No random selection was performed and it does not represent all residents.

text.zh: 實際有權核准試辦的是誰？
text.en: Who has actual authority to approve the pilot?

text.zh: 無障礙接送如何保留？
text.en: How will accessible drop-off remain available?

text.zh: 誰承擔試辦成本與引導工作？
text.en: Who pays for the pilot and coordinates crossing stewards?

text.zh: 若巷弄塞車或有人無法進出，要如何暫停？
text.en: How can the pilot pause if side streets clog or someone loses access?

text.zh: 要把公車站到入口的替代路線畫在同一張圖。
text.en: Show the route from the bus stop to the entrance on one map.

text.zh: 希望每週公開問題清單與修正方式。
text.en: Publish a weekly issue list and explain corrections.

text.zh: 到宅照顧不能因封路延誤，希望保留預約通行。
text.en: Home-care visits cannot be delayed by the closure; keep scheduled access.

text.zh: 我們住的小巷若車流增加，應有明確暫停條件。
text.en: If traffic rises on our side street, there should be a clear pause condition.

text.zh: 過街安全與學習
text.en: Crossing safety and learning

text.zh: 無障礙與照顧通行
text.en: Accessibility and care access

text.zh: 配送、生計與執行成本
text.en: Deliveries, livelihoods and implementation cost

text.zh: 巷弄影響與檢討責任
text.en: Side-street effects and review responsibility

text.zh: 先試辦四週早上二十分鐘，放學時段留待檢討。
text.en: Pilot twenty morning minutes for four weeks; review dismissal hours later.

text.zh: 共同設計無障礙接送、照顧通行與配送緩衝時間。
text.en: Co-design accessible drop-off, home-care access and delivery buffers.

text.zh: 若出入口受阻或緊急通道失效，立即暫停並檢討。
text.en: Pause and review immediately if access is blocked or the emergency route fails.

text.zh: 試辦成本由店家平均負擔。
text.en: Split pilot costs equally among local shops.

text.zh: 模擬回覆 4：本輪已連結原提問與方案；模擬主辦者提出附條件試辦草案：晨間二十分鐘、通行例外、每週檢討與明確暫停條件。經費方案未採納，需另作回覆。
text.en: Fictional response 4: this round links the source question and proposal. The fictional organizer drafts a conditional pilot: twenty morning minutes, access exceptions, weekly review and pause conditions. The cost-sharing proposal is not adopted and needs a reasoned response.

text.zh: 模擬主辦者提出附條件試辦草案：晨間二十分鐘、通行例外、每週檢討與明確暫停條件。經費方案未採納，需另作回覆。
text.en: The fictional organizer drafts a conditional pilot: twenty morning minutes, access exceptions, weekly review and pause conditions. The cost-sharing proposal is not adopted and needs a reasoned response.

text.zh: 試辦經費由誰負擔仍未解決；未採納的店家分攤方案要有理由。
text.en: Funding remains unresolved; the rejected shop cost-sharing proposal needs an explanation.

text.zh: 回到共同學習：帶入模擬觀察紀錄、經費選項和參與者更正，再檢討是否延長試辦。
text.en: Return to learning: bring simulated observations, funding options and participant corrections, then review whether the pilot should continue.

reason.zh: 回到共同學習：帶入模擬觀察紀錄、經費選項和參與者更正，再檢討是否延長試辦。
reason.en: Return to learning: bring simulated observations, funding options and participant corrections, then review whether the pilot should continue.

title.zh: 第 3 輪：檢視回覆，保留下一輪
title.en: Round 3: Review responses and keep the loop open

goal.zh: 用明確標記的虛構觀察資料示範檢討，不把支持數當成正式決定或交通改善實證。
goal.en: Use explicitly fictional observations to demonstrate review; support counts are neither a formal decision nor evidence of traffic improvement.

input.zh: 上一輪未回答的問題、決策權限與本輪範圍。
input.en: Carry-over questions, decision authority and scope.

output.zh: 用明確標記的虛構觀察資料示範檢討，不把支持數當成正式決定或交通改善實證。
output.en: Use explicitly fictional observations to demonstrate review; support counts are neither a formal decision nor evidence of traffic improvement.

guidance.zh: 先確認能改什麼、由誰回覆；本案例全部是虛構示範。
guidance.en: Clarify what can change and who must respond; this entire case is fictional.

input.zh: 議題簡介、可近用需求與上一輪的缺席聲音。
input.en: Issue brief, access needs and voices missing last round.

output.zh: 8 則表單意見；聯絡方式與意見分開保管。
output.en: 8 form comments; keep contact details separate from views.

guidance.zh: 線上表單搭配電話或現場邀請，讓夜班、照顧者與無網路者能進來。
guidance.en: Pair the online form with calls or in-person invitations so shifts, caring duties and internet access do not exclude people.

input.zh: 本輪 12 位虛構參與者的觀點分布。
input.en: The perspectives of 12 fictional participants this round.

output.zh: 涵蓋缺口紀錄；本示範採定向邀請，未做抽樣。
output.en: An inclusion-gap record; this demo uses purposive invitation, not a random sample.

guidance.zh: 大型公民會議可另用可稽核抽樣；小型工作坊也必須說清楚誰缺席。
guidance.en: For a citizens’ assembly consider auditable selection; a small workshop must still explain who is missing.

input.zh: 原始意見、背景材料與可查證的問題。
input.en: Source comments, background materials and questions that can be checked.

output.zh: 4 則 Call-in 提問，作為後續回覆的來源。
output.en: 4 Call-in questions, retained as sources for later responses.

guidance.zh: 共同讀資料、現地走讀或線上問答；保留更正與不同立場的證據。
guidance.en: Use shared reading, a site walk or online Q&A; retain corrections and evidence from different positions.

input.zh: 8 則表單意見、4 則問題及補訪。
input.en: 8 form comments, 4 questions and follow-up interviews.

output.zh: 4 則訪談意見與 4 個附來源主題。
output.en: 4 interview comments and 4 source-linked themes.

guidance.zh: Harmonica 補訪缺席聲音，TTTC 協助整理；此處主題是預先編寫的模擬，需主持人覆核。
guidance.en: Harmonica reaches missing voices and TTTC organizes material; these themes are pre-authored simulation and require facilitator review.

input.zh: 附來源的主題、提問與 4 項可修訂方案。
input.en: Source-linked themes, questions and 4 revisable proposals.

output.zh: 12 位模擬參與者 × 4 題，共 48 筆同意／不同意／略過。
output.en: 12 simulated participants × 4 statements: 48 agree/disagree/pass responses.

guidance.zh: 先討論理由再比較陳述；計數不等於共識、代表性民意或授權。少數理由仍要留下。
guidance.en: Discuss reasons, then compare statements. Counts are not consensus, representative opinion or a mandate; retain minority reasons.

input.zh: 4 項候選方案、模擬投票與原始提問。
input.en: 4 candidate proposals, simulated votes and source questions.

output.zh: 模擬回覆保留晨間試辦方向，但不宣稱交通已改善；全天方案未採納。下一輪仍須檢查巷弄影響及輪值負擔。
output.en: The fictional response keeps a morning-pilot direction without claiming improved traffic; the all-day proposal is not adopted. Side-street effects and steward workload remain for the next round.

guidance.zh: Pocket Reply 草擬逐題回覆，主辦者覆核後才形成自己的承諾；模型不能代替有權決定者。
guidance.en: Pocket Reply drafts question-linked replies; the organizer reviews before making commitments. A model cannot replace the authorized decision-maker.

input.zh: 本輪回覆、修正要求與仍未解決的問題。
input.en: This round’s responses, correction requests and unresolved questions.

output.zh: 巷弄觀察資料仍不足，放學時段與輪值負擔不可視為已解決。
output.en: Side-street observations remain insufficient; dismissal hours and steward workload are unresolved.

guidance.zh: 開啟第 4 輪的問題定義：公開哪些已改、哪些沒改，補充觀察並重新邀請缺席的人。
guidance.en: Start round 4 by reframing: explain what changed and what did not, gather observations and reinvite missing voices.

text.zh: 用明確標記的虛構觀察資料示範檢討，不把支持數當成正式決定或交通改善實證。
text.en: Use explicitly fictional observations to demonstrate review; support counts are neither a formal decision nor evidence of traffic improvement.

text.zh: 模擬檢討：接送時間比較可預期，希望維持每週回覆。
text.en: Fictional review: drop-off times feel more predictable; keep weekly responses.

text.zh: 模擬檢討：提前配送可行，但周一的告示需要更清楚。
text.en: Fictional review: earlier deliveries work, but Monday signage needs clarification.

text.zh: 模擬檢討：入口斜坡已列入修正清單，希望有完成日期。
text.en: Fictional review: the ramp is on the correction list; give it a completion date.

text.zh: 模擬檢討：巷口車流沒有足夠觀察，不能只靠印象判斷。
text.en: Fictional review: side-street traffic observations are insufficient; impressions are not enough.

text.zh: 模擬檢討：配送緩衝時間有幫助，遇到臨時訂單仍需窗口。
text.en: Fictional review: delivery buffers help, but urgent orders still need a contact process.

text.zh: 模擬檢討：輪值負擔需要檢查，不能只看工具上的支持。
text.en: Fictional review: check steward workload as well as support in the tool.

text.zh: 模擬檢討：市場工作者上一輪沒參與，請補上放學時段問題。
text.en: Fictional review: market workers missed the last round; restore the dismissal-time question.

text.zh: 模擬檢討：我用晚間表單補回意見，不應被當成已退出。
text.en: Fictional review: I rejoined through the evening form; absence should not mean permanent withdrawal.

text.zh: 這是虛構的定向邀請小組，沒有執行隨機抽樣，也不代表全體居民。
text.en: This is a fictional purposively invited group. No random selection was performed and it does not represent all residents.

text.zh: 實際有權核准試辦的是誰？
text.en: Who has actual authority to approve the pilot?

text.zh: 無障礙接送如何保留？
text.en: How will accessible drop-off remain available?

text.zh: 誰承擔試辦成本與引導工作？
text.en: Who pays for the pilot and coordinates crossing stewards?

text.zh: 若巷弄塞車或有人無法進出，要如何暫停？
text.en: How can the pilot pause if side streets clog or someone loses access?

text.zh: 模擬檢討：公車轉乘標示還要再測一次。
text.en: Fictional review: test the bus-transfer signage again.

text.zh: 模擬檢討：可延長晨間試辦，但不要直接擴大到全天。
text.en: Fictional review: extend the morning pilot without expanding straight to all day.

text.zh: 模擬檢討：照顧通行不要保存受照顧者的健康資料。
text.en: Fictional review: care access should not retain clients’ health details.

text.zh: 模擬檢討：先加強巷口觀察，再決定是否增加封閉時段。
text.en: Fictional review: improve side-street observation before adding closure hours.

text.zh: 過街安全與學習
text.en: Crossing safety and learning

text.zh: 無障礙與照顧通行
text.en: Accessibility and care access

text.zh: 配送、生計與執行成本
text.en: Deliveries, livelihoods and implementation cost

text.zh: 巷弄影響與檢討責任
text.en: Side-street effects and review responsibility

text.zh: 在完成無障礙修正與責任分工後，延長晨間試辦。
text.en: Extend the morning pilot after accessibility corrections and responsibilities are completed.

text.zh: 目前直接擴大為全天徒步區。
text.en: Expand immediately to an all-day pedestrian zone.

text.zh: 下一輪優先檢視巷弄交通、照顧通行與輪值負擔。
text.en: Prioritize side-street traffic, care access and steward workload in the next round.

text.zh: 每項未採納建議都保留理由、負責者與再檢視日期。
text.en: Keep a reason, owner and review date for every proposal not adopted.

text.zh: 模擬回覆 1：本輪已連結原提問與方案；模擬回覆保留晨間試辦方向，但不宣稱交通已改善；全天方案未採納。下一輪仍須檢查巷弄影響及輪值負擔。

text.en: Side-street observations remain insufficient; dismissal hours and steward workload are unresolved.

text.zh: 開啟第 4 輪的問題定義：公開哪些已改、哪些沒改，補充觀察並重新邀請缺席的人。

limitations.zh: 跨輪代碼僅供虛構角色示範；真實活動的聯絡資訊必須分離，不能用投票圖推斷身分。
limitations.en: Cross-round codes are fictional. Real contact records must be separate, and voting graphs must not be used to infer identities.
